image_query: Rani ki Vav stepwell Patan Gujarat
tweets: Rani ki Vav, Patan — built c. 1063 CE by Queen Udayamati for her husband Bhīma I of the Solaṅkī dynasty. An inverted temple in seven stepped levels, its walls carry over 500 sculpted panels of Viṣṇu's avatars. Buried in silt for centuries, it now graces the ₹100 note.
